title: 中国出口澳大利亚：ChAFTA原产资格
summary_zh: 澳方指引要求先确定商品编码和澳大利亚税率，再判断是否符合中澳自贸协定原产地规则；单纯经中国转运不构成优惠资格。
summary_en: The ChAFTA guide separates classification, destination tariff treatment and rules of origin. It explains that origin requirements prevent third-country transshipment from obtaining the preference.
anchor_terms: If you are importing from China
tradex_workflow: Ask the supplier for origin evidence and use Australia’s import schedule for China-to-Australia orders.
cash_effect: Compare supported preferential and non-preferential duty scenarios rather than assuming zero duty.
source_title: Guide to using ChAFTA to export or import
publisher: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
embedding_text:
中国出口澳大利亚：ChAFTA原产资格
澳方指引要求先确定商品编码和澳大利亚税率，再判断是否符合中澳自贸协定原产地规则；单纯经中国转运不构成优惠资格。
The ChAFTA guide separates classification, destination tariff treatment and rules of origin. It explains that origin requirements prevent third-country transshipment from obtaining the preference.
